# cites

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:cites`](gmeow-cites.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/cites>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/citations`](../../slices/citations.md)

Relates an entity to a creative work it cites — the flat 80%-case shortcut. Non-functional: an entity may cite many works. Promote to a [`gmeow:CitationAct`](../classes/gmeow-CitationAct.md) node when the intent, selector, provenance, or standpoint of the citation must be recorded.

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Entity`](../classes/gmeow-Entity.md) -> [`gmeow:CreativeWork`](../classes/gmeow-CreativeWork.md)
